title: Man shot in Oakville by police may be linked to woman's body
subtitle: Minutes after police fatally shot an erratic man in the parking lot of the Halton Police Service, they found the body of a 43-year-old woman in a suburban townhouse 10 minutes away
article: Minutes after police fatally shot an erratic man in the parking lot of the Halton Police Service, they found the body of a 43-year-old woman in a suburban townhouse 10 minutes away.
The woman has been identified as Katherine Newman of Oakville. The man's name has not been released.
Police have not confirmed any link between the two incidents, although witnesses say the man was the estranged husband of the dead woman.

The incident began just before 11:30 a.m., when officers emerged from the 20 District Headquarters to see a man ramming police vehicles with his car. The situation "escalated" when officers confronted the man, and he was fatally shot. News footage from the scene showed a body lying on the ground covered by a bloodied sheet - just behind a silver Nissan sedan crumpled against a police SUV.

While investigators raced to the scene of the shooting, Halton Police received a 911 call from a woman reporting the "suspicious death of an Oakville woman" at 1151 Treetop Terrace. The caller had apparently gone to the home of Ms. Newman, and called police after finding her "unresponsive."
Later in the day, Olena Lazaykina, a housekeeper from a nearby home, said she saw police outside the brick, two-storey home and a woman crying.

Two nearby schools were put on alert soon after Ms. Newman's body was found. Chris Jewell, a spokesman for the Halton Catholic District School Board, said police phoned Mother Teresa Catholic Elementary School and the St. Matthew's Catholic Elementary School and put them on "hold and secure" - similar to a lockdown, but with classes continuing as normal.
Ms. Newman is reportedly the mother of two children who are students at Mother Teresa.

Ten members of the Ontario Special Investigations Unit are investigating the shooting of the man. The SIU is called in when police are involved in incidents resulting in serious injury or death. Halton Police are investigating Ms. Newman's death.
